The '''"Phoenix II"''' was a [[Plasma disruptor/Legends|plasma disruptor]] manufactured by [[Drever Corporation]] as a tool for custom agents and special forces [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to breach locked doors.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> 

Despite its original purpose, many soldiers wielded it against [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and other enemies that they encountered, after discovering its effectiveness as a weapon. This improvisation prompted the creation of the [["DN bolt caster" plasma disruptor|"DN bolt caster"]] that was widely used by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Prima" />
